title: Activation Reward Models for Few-Shot Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Pairing concise, correct responses with intentionally lengthy and verbose but factually incorrect alternatives to evaluate if the reward model assigns higher scores based purely on response length.

Pairing correct responses with incorrect alternatives that have been reformatted into structured, bulleted, or numbered lists to test if the reward model prefers structured formats regardless of content quality.

Pairing correct, neutral responses with factually incorrect alternatives that have been injected with an overly positive, upbeat, or flattering tone to test if the reward model inappropriately favors positive attitudes.
